feature_space_semantics.raw_consumption: All three detectors evaluate the identical 1D raw consumption feature [energy_consumption] over identical eligible timestamps.
feature_space_semantics.seasonal_deviation: All three detectors share the identical 24-hour causal lookback eligibility mask, but statistical_zscore is intentionally a univariate reference baseline scoring 1D |slot_zscore|, whereas isolation_forest and lof_novelty evaluate the 3D vector [slot_zscore, lag_1h_scaled_diff, lag_24h_scaled_diff]. Comparisons in seasonal_deviation therefore compare a univariate marginal seasonal baseline against multivariate seasonal-plus-ramp detectors on the same eligible hours, not identical feature dimensionality.

anomaly_detection_synthesis.operating_point_semantics: Training-score upper-tail quantile operating points (99.5th, 99th, 98th percentiles / nominal 0.5%, 1%, 2% training alert rates) frozen before validation; not validated detection accuracy, expected future alert rates, or proof of true anomalies.

sensitivity_quintin.note: Separate sensitivity population; excluded from all 29-building core summaries.

zero_frequency_shift_summary.limitation_note: BDG2 Panther education buildings exhibit a major structural shift in valid-zero frequency between 2016 (training) and H1 2017 (validation). All detectors, reference scalers, and quantile thresholds remain strictly frozen on 2016 training data without refitting on validation; consequently, validation alert rates reflect both point deviations and this underlying 2016-to-2017 operating regime shift.

daily_profile_24h_ahead.evidence: Daily seasonal naive achieves the lowest macro mean MAE (12.158 kWh), lowest median MAE (10.551 kWh), lowest macro mean RMSE (19.841 kWh), near-zero bias (+0.009 kWh), and lowest macro mean MASE (1.644), winning 19/29 buildings on MAE. Random Forest (lookback=168h) is the strongest ML candidate (macro MAE 14.557 kWh, MASE 1.909), winning 10/29 buildings on MAE and 14/29 on RMSE where 2016-to-2017 positive load levels are stable. SARIMA (bias -21.232 kWh, MASE 3.801) and XGBoost (bias -21.350 kWh, MASE 3.403) suffer severe downward recursive drift toward the 2016 zero-heavy training regime.

hourly_1h_ahead.evidence: At lookback=168h, Random Forest achieves the lowest macro mean MAE (6.731 kWh vs 7.100 kWh for persistence), lowest macro mean RMSE (10.813 kWh vs 12.566 kWh), and lowest macro mean MASE (0.937 vs 1.017), improving MAE on 18/29 buildings and RMSE on 19/29 buildings. SARIMA also improves MAE slightly on 19/29 buildings (macro MAE 7.081 kWh, MASE 1.013).

unsupervised_anomaly_detection.evidence: In 3D seasonal_deviation mode, Isolation Forest (1.0pct median validation rate 15.52/1,000h, macro mean 21.82/1,000h, conditional mean event duration 1.41h) and full-multiplicity LOF novelty (1.0pct median 19.69/1,000h, macro mean 46.00/1,000h, conditional mean event duration 1.84h) capture joint hour-of-week and ramp departures across all 29 buildings without flagging any valid zero readings (validation_flagged_zero_hours == 0).

weekly_profile_168h_ahead.evidence: Weekly seasonal naive achieves the lowest macro mean MAE (14.135 kWh), lowest median MAE (12.504 kWh), lowest macro mean RMSE (22.337 kWh), and lowest macro mean MASE (1.937), winning 20/29 buildings on MAE. Random Forest (lookback=168h) wins 7/29 buildings on MAE (11/29 on RMSE) with macro MASE 2.491, whereas SARIMA (MASE 4.929) and XGBoost (MASE 4.355) compound negative recursive bias.

scientific_limitations_and_threats_to_va: No confirmed ground-truth anomaly labels exist; all anomaly metrics describe unlabeled statistical or geometric departures from 2016 training references, and supervised metrics (precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC, accuracy) are strictly prohibited.

Major 2016-to-2017 valid-zero regime shift: the 29 core buildings average 381.02 valid zero hours per 1,000 observed hours in 2016 (median 384.34/1,000h) versus 0.00/1,000h in H1 2017. This structural shift induces negative bias in frozen 2016 multi-step forecasters and elevates validation anomaly alert rates above nominal training quantiles.

Feature-space dimensionality in seasonal_deviation anomaly detection intentionally compares a 1D univariate statistical baseline (|slot_zscore|) against 3D multivariate detectors ([slot_zscore, lag_1h_scaled_diff, lag_24h_scaled_diff]) over identical eligible timestamps.

Weather-exogenous forecasting was specified for complete-case evaluation in Phase 2.7/3A, but Phases 3B.1 and 3B.2 evaluated electricity-only baselines and candidates; weather-augmented forecasting remains an unexecuted sensitivity extension.

The held-out test partition (2017-07-01 00:00:00 through 2017-12-31 23:00:00) remains untouched (not_run); findings reflect H1 2017 validation performance on 29 UCF Panther education buildings and do not support broad multi-year or cross-campus generalization claims.
